hints.tr: Üç döngü: `for i in range(n):`, `for j in range(i + 1, n):`, `for k in range(j + 1, n):`; en içte `count += 1`.
hints.en: Three loops: `for i in range(n):`, `for j in range(i + 1, n):`, `for k in range(j + 1, n):`; innermost `count += 1`.

hints.tr: Döngüde `if previous is None: print(n, current)` değilse oranı da yazdır; turun sonunda `previous = current`.
hints.en: In the loop, `if previous is None: print(n, current)`, otherwise print the ratio too; at the end of the round `previous = current`.
